title: Meh
text: Meh. It worked on 3 of 4 of the first cans I tried it on. I think that it’s cumbersome enough I’ll probably use the hand opener. It’s slower than I thought it would be. The cut edge doesn’t feel too sharp. I’ve had it go off in the drawer if it gets bumped by a utensil.
